summary:
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#94](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/94)** — A dedicated CUDA path was added to `ONNXInferenceModel`, binding ONNX outputs directly to CUDA device memory and ensuring the output tensor of the metric-learning stage is on the correct device for ACTS' `buildEdgesFRNN`. Node-feature inputs for downstream edge classifiers are copied straight into an ACTS tensor in device memory, forcing `OnnxEdgeClassifier` to run on CUDA and bypassing the previous std::vector → torch tensor → ActsTensor conversion.
- **[key4hep/k4ActsTracking#110](https://github.com/key4hep/k4ActsTracking/pull/110)** — The wget-based retrieval of tracking geometry/material-map data (MAIA, MuColl, MuSIC) was replaced by CMake's `ExternalData` mechanism with per-file `.md5` descriptors, simplifying and standardising data acquisition at build time.
- **[key4hep/k4Reco#70](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Reco/pull/70)** — Conversion of `TrackerHit3D` was added to the KalTest machinery (`GaudiDDKalTestTrack`), restoring parity with the original Marlin implementation. This fixes a long-standing reconstruction issue tracked in k4GaudiPandora; note that `COMPOSITE_SPACEPOINT` FTD hits in ILD remain unhandled.
- **[key4hep/k4PFHitML#4](https://github.com/key4hep/k4PFHitML/pull/4)** — Events containing no calorimeter hits or tracks are now skipped before invoking the clustering model, fixing a crash observed in the nightly CI.
- **[key4hep/DDML#19](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/19)** — A new `ddml` Python module was introduced, providing `ddml_physics` and `add_shower_model` helpers plus pre-configured settings for shipped models. This replaces the organically grown, barely maintainable `ddsim_steer.py` with a `ModelConfig`-based design so adding a new fast-sim model is a matter of writing a config object rather than extending `if/else` chains across ONNX and Torch inference paths.
- **[key4hep/DDML#16](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/16)** — ML inference model initialisation was moved out of the event loop and run upfront, geometry initialisation was deferred so DD4hep settings are available, the interface concepts were completed, and the default was switched to non-hadron showers.
- **[key4hep/DDML#20](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/20)** — The ONNX and Torch inference backends now only copy the elements that the model actually returned into the output buffer, rather than filling it to capacity. The previous behaviour copied garbage past the valid data and had only avoided segfaults by luck of page sizes.
- **[key4hep/DDML#34](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/34)** — The BIBAE two-angle model (`BIBAE_Two_Angle_Full_PP_cut.pt`) was added for retrieval via `ExternalData`, expanding the set of ready-to-use fast-sim models.
- **[key4hep/DDML#18](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/18)** — The example CaloClouds3 configuration was fixed to use the proper model for the Endcap region.
- **[key4hep/DDML#17](https://github.com/key4hep/DDML/pull/17)** — A basic runtime check was added using CaloClouds3 to verify the fast-sim pipeline runs end-to-end and produces readable output files containing the expected `MCParticle::isHandledByFastSim` flagging; a dormant reference-counting issue in `CaloCloudsTwoAngleModel` was worked around by intentionally leaking a resource.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#433](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/433)** — Boolean properties can finally be switched off from the `k4run` command line. Previously both `type=bool` (where `bool("False")` is True) and the `propertyNoValue` default path left properties stuck at True; a dedicated parser accepting True/False, true/false, 1/0 now rejects anything else, and a bare flag means True instead of silently becoming False.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#436](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/436)** — Gaudi v41r1 is now required for the EventContext data-handle API, since the needed changes did not land in 41.0.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#438](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/438)** — The Gaudi major-version check (41) was restored for `EmptyTypeList` in `Consumer.h`/`Transformer.h`, dropping the stricter v41r1 requirement from #436 that applied only to the EventContext API. This removes spurious warnings when building against Gaudi v41r0.
- **[key4hep/k4FWCore#437](https://github.com/key4hep/k4FWCore/pull/437)** — The k4FWCore Python package is now installed to `${GAUDI_INSTALL_PYTHONDIR}` instead of a hardcoded `python/`. Gaudi v41r0 changed its install layout so plugins live under `lib/gaudi-plugins` and Python under `lib/pythonX.Y/site-packages`; without this, nothing using `IOSvc` could run.
- **[key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper#489](https://github.com/key4hep/k4MarlinWrapper/pull/489)** — The deprecated `inputReader` module was removed, as it relied on `PodioInput` which has been removed from `k4FWCore`. Users should switch to `k4MarlinWrapper.io_helpers`.
- **[key4hep/k4SimDelphes#162](https://github.com/key4hep/k4SimDelphes/pull/162)** — The `DelphesEDM4HepConverter` now assigns a pion mass to all tracks that are not electrons or muons, keeping energy/mass/momentum consistent, and populates PDG IDs for tracks and leptons so analysts no longer have to infer particle identity from the mass. Jet energy/mass consistency with constituents is also enforced and tested.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#101](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/101)** — The `GenfitTrackFitter` helix-to-Cartesian conversion was corrected: Jacobian units were fixed for GENFIT/EDM4hep consistency, the `z0` unit conversion was fixed, and a singular initial covariance in `z0` for seeds near the reference point is now prevented. EDM4hep track states now use GENFIT native extrapolation to the point of closest approach, with the first and last digitised hits serving as references for `AtFirstHit`/`AtLastHit`; broken hit–track associations from the filtering stage were also repaired.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#97](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/97)** — A `K4RECTRACKER_TRACKING` CMake flag (default ON) was added to gate compilation of the FCCee tracking components, enabling the package to be built in the Muon Collider stack which does not ship Marlin/LCIO. This requires propagation to spack and lcgcmake recipes.
- **[key4hep/k4RecTracker#106](https://github.com/key4hep/k4RecTracker/pull/106)** — `TrackMerger` was updated to call `getTrackState` with the `edm4hep::TrackState::Location` enum instead of a raw `int32_t`, resolving the deprecation warning introduced by EDM4hep#493.
- **[hep-fcc/k4RecCalorimeter#285](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/k4RecCalorimeter/pull/285)** — Onnxruntime ≥ 1.16.0 is now required and the custom `FindONNXRuntime.cmake` was deleted in favour of the upstream-provided `onnxruntime::onnxruntime` CMake target.
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#383](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/383)** — A full IDEA option 2 (`IDEA_o2_v01`) reconstruction configuration and CTest were added based on the reduced geometry, including steering and digi/reco scripts, extending full-sim coverage for the IDEA detector.
- **[hep-fcc/FCC-config#400](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCC-config/pull/400)** — A new EvtGen decay card `Lb2L1520NuNu.dec` was added for `Lambda_b0 → Lambda(1520)0 ν_e ν̄_e` followed by `Lambda(1520)0 → p+ K-` (and charge conjugate), validated with 200 events using the winter2023 stack.
- **[hep-fcc/FCCAnalyses#561](https://github.com/HEP-FCC/FCCAnalyses/pull/561)** — Handling of HTCondor log and output files was updated for the pre-edm4hep1 stack so that benign HTCondor warnings no longer trigger ten retry submissions and duplicate job clusters.
- **[key4hep/k4geo#665](https://github.com/key4hep/k4geo/pull/665)** — The IDEA `SteeringFile_IDEA_o1_v03.py` now disables the worker event-sharing flag when running single-threaded, following up on the fix in AIDASoft/DD4hep#1678.
- **[key4hep/k4Bench#202](https://github.com/key4hep/k4Bench/pull/202)** — The nightly workflow now re-reads the CVMFS-provided view identity for up to 360 s before failing the release check, tolerating stale weekday slots served by CVMFS while still failing cleanly if the requested release never appears.
